description: Defines the CategoryEntity class, a serializable entity representing a product category, with properties like sort order, visibility, code, and lineage, extending the Category base class.

classes.name: CategoryEntity
classes.description: A serializable Java class representing a product category with attributes for sort order, visibility, code, and lineage, extending the Category class.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the sort order of the category.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order of the category.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Returns whether the category is visible.

methods.name: setVisible
methods.description: Sets the visibility status of the category.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the code associated with the category.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code for the category.

methods.name: getLineage
methods.description: Retrieves the lineage string of the category.

methods.name: setLineage
methods.description: Sets the lineage string of the category.
